title: Hausdorff measure of a rotated 1-Lipschitz graph over a ball (fact Gr)
statement: For n >= 1, l, a linear isometry q of R^(n+l), f : R^n -> R^l with |f(x) - f(z)| <= |x - z| for all x, z, c in R^n and r >= 0: H^n(q(graph of f over the closed ball B^n_r(c))) <= 2^(n/2) omega_n r^n.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ), (∀ x z, ‖f x - f z‖ ≤ ‖x - z‖) → ∀ (c : Rn n) (r : ℝ), 0 ≤ r → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (q '' graphOver f (closedBall c r)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) * unitBallVolume n * r ^ n)
